_note: woo-dossier-shared-with-the-requester. The requester answers a question from Mijn zaken (REQ-WDS-001): the request keeps the answer as written and says whether it asks for documents or for a clarification (REQ-WDS-004). The case carries two fields in the shapes of portaliq's portalCase (portaliq woo-dossier-in-my-cases REQ-WDM-002 and REQ-WDM-003): termNote, the sentence about the term, and resultLink, where the decision is public. Written by dossiq only.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Whether the request asks for missing documents or for a clarification of a Woo request that is too broad (Woo art. 4.1 lid 5). A clarification asks one question and lists no documents.

applicantAnswer.title: Answer from the applicant
applicantAnswer.description: What the applicant wrote back from the portal, as they wrote it. Only the handler closes the request.

applicantAnsweredAt.title: Answered in the portal at
applicantAnsweredAt.description: When the applicant sent their answer from the portal.

termNote.title: Term note
termNote.description: One sentence for the requester about the term: standing still, or extended with the reason. Empty while the term runs. Set by dossiq, not by hand.

resultLink.title: Result link
resultLink.description: Where the requester reads what was made public. Set by dossiq when the Woo decision is published, cleared when the publication is withdrawn.

label.title: Link text
label.description: The words the requester reads on the link.

url.title: Link address
url.description: The address of the publication, always the case's own Woo publication link.
